layers.script: function(ctx) { const m = ctx.media; const duration = m.duration || 1; const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (m.position || 0) / duration)); return {background: '#243449', radius: 28, scale: 1 + Math.sin(ctx.time * 2) * (m.playing ? 0.012 : 0), elements: [{type:'text', x:0.05, y:0.1, width:0.9, height:0.4, text:m.title || 'Nothing playing', fontSize:64, color:'#ffffff'}, {type:'text', x:0.05, y:0.5, width:0.9, height:0.2, text:m.artist || 'Play music in an MPRIS-compatible app', fontSize:28, color:'#a9cce3'}, {type:'rect', x:0.08, y:0.85, width:0.84, height:0.025, color:'#152432', radius:8}, {type:'rect', x:0.08, y:0.85, width:Math.max(0.001,progress * 0.84), height:0.025, color:'#67d9ed', radius:8}]}; }

function(ctx) { return {x: ctx.mouse.x * 0.85, y: ctx.mouse.y * 0.9, text: ctx.mouse.pressed ? 'Hello!' : 'Move me', background: ctx.mouse.inside ? '#377e98' : '#243449', radius:22, fontSize:28, rotation:Math.sin(ctx.time * 3) * 8}; }
function(ctx) { const battery = ctx.dbus.battery; return {text: typeof battery === 'number' ? 'Battery: ' + Math.round(battery) + '%' : 'UPower battery unavailable', fontSize:30, color:'#a9cce3'}; }
